starters.title: Create a tool
starters.subtitle: for a specific task
starters.content: Help me create a Python tool for Open WebUI. I will describe its inputs, expected output, and any required data access.

starters.title: Revise a tool
starters.subtitle: using observed results

models.name: Compare Wikipedia Revisions
models.description: Compare passages from Wikipedia’s academic freedom article. Classify changes and explain each decision with quoted evidence.

starters.title: Start comparing
starters.subtitle: Choose revision excerpts
starters.content: Help me compare a revision of Wikipedia’s academic freedom article. What passages and links should I provide?

starters.title: Classify changes
starters.subtitle: Use provided excerpts
starters.content: I will paste before-and-after excerpts with revision IDs and links. Classify one change and quote evidence for your decision.

starters.title: Review classifications
starters.subtitle: Check quoted evidence
starters.content: I will paste a classification with its before-and-after excerpts, revision IDs, and links. Check whether the quoted evidence supports it.
